## Professional Summary
Huzaifa Malik (known professionally as exhuzaifa and Muhammad Huzaifa Tabassum) is an AI Software Engineer with 3+ years of production experience designing and deploying autonomous multi-agent systems, enterprise retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, and full-stack AI applications. He is also a security researcher acknowledged by the NASA Vulnerability Disclosure Program (VDP) for identifying and reporting a Severe (P1) vulnerability.

## Core Technical Competencies
- **Autonomous Agents & AI Workflows:** LangChain, LangGraph, Multi-Agent Orchestration, Tool Calling, OpenAI API, Anthropic Claude, Gemini 1.5, DeepSeek, Local LLMs (Ollama, vLLM).
- **Enterprise RAG Architectures:** Hybrid Search (Dense Embeddings + BM25 Sparse), Context-Aware Chunking, Vector Databases (Pinecone, ChromaDB, Qdrant, Supabase pgvector), Reranking (Cohere), Contextual Compression.
- **Workflow Automation & Integration:** n8n Workflow Automation, Self-Hosted Agents, REST APIs, Webhooks, CRM Integrations.
- **Full-Stack Software Engineering:** Python, FastAPI, Django, JavaScript, TypeScript, React.js, Vite, Next.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, Git.
- **Security & Vulnerability Research:** Threat Modeling, NASA VDP P1 Severity Reporter, Bug Bounty.

## Featured Projects
- **Kalengh (Techsynx/kalengh):** Discreet real-time AI assistant for live screen and audio contextual assistance.
- **Bank Customer Churn MLOps Pipeline:** End-to-end MLOps pipeline predicting customer churn with 92% ROC-AUC, automated retraining, and FastAPI inference.
- **Poultry AI Predictor:** Computer vision and predictive analytics for agricultural yield and livestock health detection.
- **3D Interactive Web Experiences:** WebGL, Three.js, React Three Fiber, GSAP scroll choreography.
